summary: nginx 1.31.9 and 1.30.7 fix ten issues published on the nginx.org security page after the 18 November scan. The page's anchor text for the HTTP/3 use-after-free writes the CVE prefix twice; the identifier is CVE-2026-121810. CVE-2026-120993 is mainline only, 1.31.4 through 1.31.8, fixed in 1.31.9. The other nine name 1.31.9 and 1.30.7. CVE-2026-123634 is NVD Received with no CPE. The floors are the nginx.org page.
remediation: Upgrade nginx to 1.31.9 or newer on the mainline, or to 1.30.7 or newer on the 1.30 line.
